title: Ryu Hyeyoung recounts cast seeing same female ghost in Korea motel
excerpt: Ryu Hyeyoung recounts cast seeing same female ghost in Korea motel
content:
입력 2026.10.19. 20:00

Actor Ryu Hyeyoung revealed a chilling anecdote that fellow actors saw the same ghost in the same lodging during filming.

On the 19th, a video titled "Dopamine addiction survival thriller Killing Time | RAPL Weekly HOT & NEW ep.33 - Killing Time" was posted on the YouTube channel "Lifeplus."

That day, Nam Yoon Su and Ryu Hyeyoung, who appear in the film "Killing Time," talked about the strange experiences they had or heard about on actual sets.

First, Nam Yoon Su was asked whether he had ever seen a ghost on set, and he replied, "I sleep so well I haven't had that experience." However, he said, "I heard that a fellow actor saw a ghost in the lodging right before filming," which piqued curiosity.

Ryu Hyeyoung said, "Yoon Su didn't feel anything at all," and added, "I'm not someone who sees ghosts either, so I don't really know, but several cast members said they saw the same ghost in the same motel lodging." She especially emphasized, "It was the same room number," which surprised listeners. The actors had stayed in that room on different days, yet all witnessed a similar female ghostly figure.

Ryu Hyeyoung recalled, "They said they saw it on different days but it was the exact same female ghost. Hearing that on set gave me chills." She continued, "After finishing filming and returning to the lodging, I would pray before sleeping that I wouldn't see a ghost so I could sleep," she confessed, prompting both laughter and goosebumps.

Hearing this, An Hyun Mo joked toward Ryu Hyeyoung, "Hyeyoung is a ghost of acting. She's even in the encyclopedia and pages," drawing laughter. Nam Yoon Su also reacted, "That's scary," adding to the amusement. The strange eyewitness accounts circulated among fellow actors on set created tension rivaling that of the film itself.
